submit.pageSubtitle: Submit your grievance to municipal authorities with text, voice recordings, photos, and video proof.
submit.anonymousBannerDesc: You can report anonymously or logged in. A municipal Tracking Code (e.g. CMP-YYYYMMDD-XXXX) will be generated for public status tracking.
submit.titlePlaceholder: e.g., Severe Water Pipe Burst at Main Square
submit.categoryHelp: Choose the municipal domain matching your grievance
submit.descPlaceholder: Describe the location, severity, duration, and safety risk...
submit.priorityHelp: Deterministic priority rule: life-threat and hazard complaints are auto-escalated to Urgent/High.
submit.addressPlaceholder: Enter street name, ward number, or landmark
submit.pickMapHelp: Click anywhere on the map below to pinpoint exact incident coordinates
submit.audioHelp: Record a voice complaint directly from your browser (up to 2 mins) or upload an audio file.
submit.photosHelp: Upload photos of the civic defect (JPEG, PNG, WebP up to 5MB each).
submit.videoHelp: Upload a short on-site video clip (MP4, WebM up to 25MB).
submit.successModalSubtitle: Your complaint has been logged in the municipal system.
submit.previewPlaceholder: Enter issue title in the form to preview ticket...

track.title: Grievance Redressal Tracker
track.subtitle: Track municipal action and field engineer updates in real time using your unique Tracking Code.
track.stepSubmittedDesc: Registered in municipal database and assigned tracking ID.
track.stepAssignedDesc: Assigned to department engineer and field crew.
track.stepInProgressDesc: Municipal maintenance team dispatched on site.
track.stepResolvedDesc: Field repairs verified with completion proof.
track.rateDesc: Your grievance has been marked as resolved. Please submit your satisfaction rating.
track.feedbackThanks: Thank you for your valuable citizen feedback!
track.noComplaintFound: No grievance found with this tracking code. Please verify the code and try again.
